changes.encoding_order: UTF-16 decoding is attempted before permissive legacy encodings
changes.header_detection: A row containing at least two finite numeric cells is treated as data, not a header.

classification: Prospective endpoints with a disclosed post-access format repair; not a byte-identical fully prospective execution.
claim_boundary: The repair permits execution of the frozen case selection, response statistic and thresholds. It does not rescue a failed endpoint, justify outcome-specific column selection, or support absolute concentration, HRS dispersion, detector placement, ESD or consequence-distance validation.
